title: SkyBlock Menu
wikitext: {{Infobox/Item |image = SkyBlock Menu.png |source = Logging in on SkyBlock |uses = Accessing Menu |enchant = No |reforge = No |auctionable = No |tradeable = No |id = SKYBLOCK_MENU }} The '''SkyBlock Menu''' is the main Hypixel SkyBlock menu. You can access your general SkyBlock info, your SkyBlock profile, SkyBlock settings, and the Hypixel Menu. The item is located on the last slot of your hotbar. == How to open == To access the '''SkyBlock Menu''', either: * Right-click or left-click the item when it's in your main hand. * Open your inventory, then click on the item. * Open chat and run the command {{code|/sbmenu}}. *Drop the item in any form. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Buttons == Note: The bottom-left button has the location ID of (1, 1) and the top-right button has location ID of (9, 6). {| class="wikitable" !Image !Button !Function !Location !Unlocking |- |[[File:Player_Head.png|64px|center]] |Stats & Equipment |Opens your [[Equipment Menu]]. |5; 5 |{{bc}} |- |[[File:Diamond Sword.png|64px|center]] |[[Skills|Your Skills]] |Opens the Skills Menu. |2; 4 |{{bc}} |- |[[File:Painting.png|64px|center]] |[[Collection|Collections]] |Opens the Collections Menu. |3; 4 |{{bc}} |- |[[File:Book.png|64px|center]] |[[Recipe Book]] |Opens the Recipe Book. |4; 4 |{{bc}} |- |[[File:SkyBlock Experience Icon.png|alt=SkyBlock Leveling Icon|64px|center]] |[[SkyBlock Levels|Skyblock Leveling]] |Opens the [[SkyBlock Levels|SkyBlock Leveling]] menu. |5; 4 |{{bc}} |- |[[File:Book and Quill.png|64px|center]] |[[Quests & Chapters|Quest & Chapters]] |Opens the [[Quests & Chapters]] menu. |6; 4 |{{bc}} |- |[[File:Clock.png|64px|center]] |[[Calendar and Events]] |Opens the calendar. Only available when you have an active Booster Cookie. |7; 1 |{{bc}} |} == Tips == * As some of your stats such as {{stat|hp}} or {{stat|cc}} might change when holding a certain item, you can check your stats with the item on your hand by accessing Your SkyBlock Profile in your SkyBlock Menu by selecting it in your inventory, or via using the command /sbmenu with the item in your hand. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/July 15|Renamed {{Green|Your SkyBlock Profile}} to {{Green|Stats & Equipment}}.}} |beta= {{History|2019/June 11|[[File:SkyBlock Menu.png|x26px]] Added SkyBlock Menu.}} {{History|2019/July 9|Now show personal ranking for skills and collections XP.}} {{History|2019/August 2|The Skill/Collections ranking menus have been tweaked.}} {{History|2019/September 11|[[Quiver]] arrow now replaces the SkyBlock Menu while holding a [[Bow]].}} {{History|2019/December 18|Added warps to Event locations.}} {{History|2020/June 2|Added [[Wardrobe]].}} {{History|2020/June 7|Added [[Sack of Sacks]].}} {{History|2020/September 8|Added [[Booster Cookie]]s and Potion effects}} {{History|2021/April 20|The [[Ender Chest]] is removed and replaced with [[Storage]].}} {{History|2023/Feb 2|Added [[SkyBlock Guide]].}} {{History|0.26.1|Renamed {{Green|Your SkyBlock Profile}} to {{Green|Stats & Equipment}}.}} }} [[Category:Mechanics]] [[Category:SkyBlock Menu]] [[Category:Pages with UIs]]
